description_html:
Wacom one 14


14-inch Full HD pen display for beginners and students

Start your digital adventure with the all-new Wacom One 14. Ideal for casual artists and visual thinkers. With the Wacom One drawing tablet with screen you can draw, sketch, edit photos, take notes, annotate, and discover your creative passion.


Larger active area for larger ideas

The redesigned Wacom One features a spacious 14” screen, perfect for digital art, annotation, and photo editing. Its bonded display reduces parallax for accurate pen placement, while the anti-glare, anti-fingerprint coating adds just the right amount of friction—giving you a natural, paper-like drawing feel with every stroke.


Never put your pen down

It comes with the Wacom One pen, which features Wacom’s leading pen technology in an easy-to-use format: it’s lightweight, easy to grip, and battery-free. It delivers exceptional accuracy, virtually no lag, and natural tilt recognition, all backed by over 40 years of Wacom expertise. It also includes two programmable pen buttons for your favorite shortcuts. The Wacom One is also compatible with third-party pens from trusted brands like Staedtler, LAMY, and Dr. Grip, giving you more ways to create with comfort and precision.



Single cable connectivity

Connect the Wacom One to your laptop or PC with a single USB-C cable.* Keep your working area free from clutter or messy cables so you can focus on what matters most. The single-cable connection is ideal for smaller workspaces or mobile users. The USB-C cable provides power, video and data – so you can slip the Wacom One in your backpack, right next to your laptop.


*Thunderbolt port (x3 or later) or Display Port alt-mode support required. Adapter for PCs without DP Alt-Mode must use the Wacom Converter (sold separately).


Start drawing immediately with bundled software

Not sure where to start, software-wise, or want to level up your skills? The Wacom One pen display comes with a bundle of software trials, like CLIP STUDIO PAINT PRO, as well as a trial subscription to Skillshare™.


*Wacom ID required.


Sustainable packaging design

The new Wacom One continues Wacom’s commitment to environmental sustainability. It prioritizes the use of sustainable materials in the packaging – for example, we’ve eliminated all petroleum-derived plastics and shifted to 97% FSC certified paper for our printed materials.


Get complimentary software offers with every Wacom One*

*To get your complimentary software, you need to sign-in or create a Wacom ID with your personal data and register your Wacom One.


What's Included

1 x Display Device

1 x Wacom One Standard Pen

3 x Wacom One Pen Standard Nib

1 x nib removal tool

1 x USB Type-C Cable (1.8m)

1 x Quick Start Guide

1x Important Product Information document

description_html_ar:
استمتع بالرسم على شاشة بمقاس 14 بوصة وتعطيك ملمس القلم الطبيعي على شاشة تشبه ملمس الورق.

كما تتميز بشاشة IPS بدقة  1920 × 1080 بكسل، كما أنها مقاومة للتوهج والبصمات، وتدعم 98٪ للتدرج اللوني من معيار sRGB.


 انطلق بلا حدود

استمتع بالرسم بقلم لا يحتاج إلى شحن أو بطارية للعمل، ويدعم القلم 4096 مستوى من مستويات
حساسية الضغط، ويدعم حتى 60 درجة من حساسية الإمالة  


احصل على تجربة قلم مصحوبة بالدقة عند استخدامه مع جهازك على عكس الماوس أو لوحة التتبع، فإنه يسمح بالعمل بتفاصيل دقيقة مهما كانت المهمة التي تقوم بها بمعنى أن ما ترسمه هو ما تراه. 


اتصال سهل
وصل الشاشة من خلال كابل USB-C 

*يتطلب منفذ Thunderbolt (x3 أو أحدث أو USB-C يدعم DP alt mode 

يجب استخدام محول Wacom لأجهزة الكمبيوتر التي لا تدعم DP alt mode مع محول Wacom (يُباع منفصلًا).

التوافق

- Windows 10 أو أحدث

- macOS 11 أو  أحدث

- نظام التشغيل Android بإصدار 8.0 أو أحدث

- نظام التشغيل Chrome OS


المحتويات

- شاشة واكوم وان 14

-  كابل USB-C

- قلم واكوم 

- محول الطاقة

- 3 x سنون

- مشبك استبدال السن 

1 x Quick Start Guide

1x Important Product Information document
